# Brian Jester's Portfolio

> Personal project portfolio covering software development, amateur radio, education, investing, and travel.

The canonical homepage is https://brianjester.github.io/. Project names and summaries are listed on the homepage and in the repository README. Follow each linked project for its current features and details.

## Portfolio

- [Homepage](https://brianjester.github.io/): Project cards and portfolio overview.
- [README project directory](https://github.com/brianjester/brianjester.github.com/blob/master/README.md): Curated project names, descriptions, and links.
- [XML sitemap](https://brianjester.github.io/sitemap.xml): Public HTML pages on this site.
- [Crawler rules](https://brianjester.github.io/robots.txt): Crawler access policy.

## Featured projects

- [ValueSlope](https://brianjester.github.io/value-slope/): Interactive comparison of annualized S&P 500 stock-price changes and return smoothness.
- [Travel Guide: Castles of Okinawa](https://a.co/d/4BS9E7q): Travel guide to Okinawan castles, attractions, and food.
- [Fun Filipino Words and Culture](https://a.co/d/4WbDkpE): Bilingual children's book in Tagalog and English.
- [IndexFlip](http://indexflip.com): Flashcards and practice tests.
- [DMR QRZ](http://dmrqrz.com): Digital Mobile Radio contact lookup.
- [Cabrillo Log](https://github.com/brianjester/brianjester.github.com/tree/master/cabrillo-log): Amateur Radio contest log tool.
- [SOTA Logs](https://github.com/brianjester/brianjester.github.com/tree/master/sota-log): Summits on the Air CSV logs.
- [Passive Income](https://brianjester.github.io/passive-income/): Side-project passive income chart.
- [Morse Code Key](https://brianjester.github.io/morse/): In-browser Morse code key.
- [USGS Earthquake Map](https://github.com/brianjester/myExpressApp): Express and Mapbox earthquake map project.
- [Castles of Okinawa Companion Site](https://brianjester.github.io/okinawa-castles/): Companion site for the travel guide.
